svg.title: The lab adds scoped controls and response authority
svg.desc: Keep isolation, monitoring, clocks, grader revision and pause controls distinct. Multiple defenses address different stages and must not collapse into one impenetrable shield. Visual distinction: A bounded workload tray with a large pause pair and a stop bar. A temporary operational disposition, not a breached wall or permanent destruction.
